business_problem: In February 2020, with the entry of partner Microsoft, AlfaPeople, Via began to explore more features offered for Dynamics 365, streamlining the service of sellers and, as a result, gaining more agility in the entry of retailers.
solution_summary: In February 2020, with the entry of partner Microsoft, AlfaPeople, Via began to explore more features offered for Dynamics 365, streamlining the service of sellers and, as a result, gaining more agility in the entry of retailers. The company has built a robust framework where Microsoft 365 powers remote work, with Windows Virtual Desktop being utilized by sales team and security layers so the operation can flow smoothly. Dynamics 365 optimizes the process of getting new Sellers into the marketplace - which once took 140 days and now only 3 minutes - and everything is supported by Azure Digital commerce has long been not only a trend, but also a reality for retail workers. A good experience for consumer and partner sellers, as well as a robust framework to support peak accesses from periods of the year like Black Friday, are imperative for those looking to thrive in this new retail context. At the heart of all this is the modernization of data management.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Processes and transforms large datasets for analytics, modeling, and downstream reporting.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Factory
solution_components.role: Orchestrates and ingests data pipelines from operational source systems into the analytics platform.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Runs the customer's containerized applications and AI services on a managed Kubernetes platform.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can monitor operations and act on live insights.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: Gives service teams a unified workspace for cases, customer context, and responses.

data_flow: Operational data is ingested through Azure Data Factory processed in Azure Databricks and published to teams through Power BI dashboards.
